cases.question: I have a planned admission under HDFC ERGO Arogya Sanjeevani. How early must I notify the insurer?

cases.question: For HDFC ERGO Arogya Sanjeevani, how soon should I submit hospital and pre-hospitalization reimbursement bills after discharge?

cases.question: If I renew HDFC ERGO Arogya Sanjeevani, how does its cumulative bonus build up and what is the cap?

cases.question: My covered surgery under Digit Group Complete Protect finished in a few hours. Can a procedure under 24 hours count as day care?
cases.gold_fact: stay less than 24 hrs because of technological advancement
cases.gold_notes: Day-care procedures can be covered for an illness or accidental injury when treatment is under general or local anesthesia and the stay is under 24 hours because of technological advancement. Ordinary outpatient treatment is excluded from this cover.

cases.question: If I add the infertility treatment benefit to Digit Group Complete Protect, what waiting period applies?
cases.gold_fact: A waiting period of 48 months will apply
cases.gold_notes: The infertility treatment cover is optional and has a 48-month waiting period, provided it has been continuously renewed with that benefit from inception. The maximum payable per hospitalization is schedule-specific.

cases.question: My transplant requires a living donor. What donor expenses can Digit Group Complete Protect pay?
cases.gold_fact: up to 5% of the claim amount approved in respect of harvesting expenses
cases.gold_notes: If the Organ Donor cover is opted, the wording pays the donor's pre- and post-hospitalization expenses up to 5% of the claim amount approved for harvesting. It excludes other medical treatment for the donor after harvesting; legal transplant conditions and the waiting period also apply.

cases.question: I needed a road ambulance during an emergency covered by Digit Group Complete Protect. Is there a per-hospitalization cap?
cases.gold_fact: maximum liability per Hospitalization is restricted to the amount as mentioned in Your Policy Schedule
cases.gold_notes: Road ambulance for an emergency is payable only where an inpatient hospitalization claim under Section 26.B is accepted; liability per hospitalization is limited to the amount in the Policy Schedule. Medically necessary transfer to the nearest suitable hospital is also described.

cases.question: Does Digit Group Complete Protect automatically cover pregnancy, and how many living children can the maternity benefit cover?
cases.gold_fact: limited to cover up to two living children
cases.gold_notes: Maternity benefit applies only if opted and is limited to two living children. The benefit limit and waiting period are the amounts opted and recorded in the Policy Schedule; the policy also states a spouse-coverage condition unless waived by the insurer.

cases.question: If my newborn is added to Digit Group Complete Protect, until what age can the policy pay for vaccinations?
cases.gold_fact: until the New Born Baby attains 5 Years of age
cases.gold_notes: Once the newborn is added as an insured person, reasonable and customary charges for vaccinations under the National Immunization Schedule can be paid until age five, subject to continuous renewal with the maternity and newborn cover from inception.

cases.question: When can I claim home treatment instead of hospital admission under Digit Group Complete Protect?
cases.gold_notes: If domiciliary cover is opted, the condition must be such that the patient cannot be moved to hospital or a hospital room is unavailable, and treatment must continue for at least three days. Listed conditions are excluded, subject to the wording.

cases.question: If I use up the hospital sum insured, does Digit Group Complete Protect refill it for another claim?
cases.gold_fact: We will refill 100% of the Sum Insured specified and utilized
cases.gold_notes: If the Sum Insured Refill Benefit is opted, the wording provides a refill of 100% of the Sum Insured specified and utilized under the covered hospitalization sections for that policy period, subject to the benefit's terms.

cases.question: Will Digit Group Complete Protect reimburse routine doctor visits and medicines, or do I need a specific OPD benefit?
